text: {"lessons":["Selling part of Stock B after strong gains felt satisfying, but I should avoid trimming only because a gain feels good; consider the stock’s prospects and my target allocation.","Selling Stock C at a profit did not prevent my account value from falling, so judge decisions by the whole portfolio and longer-term results, not one realized gain.","I trade rarely, so I should make deliberate, planned decisions rather than react to short-term account changes, while keeping enough cash and diversification for flexibility."]}
